description: Read-only XRPL payment-path discovery for planning a Payment from source_account to destination_account. destination_amount is the exact amount the destination should receive, provided as XRP drops or an issued-currency object; the result returns candidate path alternatives and source-amount information to compare before constructing the payment. Use this when XRPL routing is needed between the source and destination accounts; use n9t2_xrpl_get_book_offers for DEX order-book depth instead. This tool only discovers paths and does not construct, sign, submit, or modify any XRPL transaction; after selecting a route, use n9t2_xrpl_prepare_transaction to build the unsigned payment.

destination_account.description: XRPL classic account address that will receive the destination amount.
destination_account.title: Destination Account

destination_amount.description: Destination amount to deliver. Use a string for XRP drops or an issued-currency object containing currency, issuer, and value.
destination_amount.title: Destination Amount

source_account.description: XRPL classic account address used as the source of payment-path discovery.
source_account.title: Source Account

name: n9t2_xrpl_find_path
